entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker that I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number please?
Sure, it's VF8675309.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 14 days ago, on December 19th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's a preference thing. It works fine, but it's just not the right fit for my routine. I'd like to return it for a refund.

I understand. Looking at our policy for the VeloBand Pulse, it has a strict 10-day return window due to hygiene protocols and how the device activates. I see we are currently on day 14, which is unfortunately outside of that period.

I expected you might say that, but here's the situation. I actually tried to process the return on December 28th, which would have been day 9. I went through the entire online portal, but when I clicked the final button, I got a 'website error' message. The whole system seemed to be down.
I see. So you attempted the return within the 10-day window, but our system prevented you from completing it?
Exactly. I tried for about an hour. The page just wouldn't load properly, so I couldn't print the return label. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I figured this might happen.

Thank you for providing that detail, I appreciate your patience. Let me check our internal logs for that date... Ah, yes. I do see a note here confirming a major system down event on the 28th that affected our returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience.
Okay, so you can see it was a problem on your end?

Yes, absolutely. Since the issue was a VeloFit business fault, I am more than happy to make an exception and process this return for a full refund for you. I will email you a prepaid return label right now.

That's great, thank you, Charlie. I appreciate you looking into that. Now, since I did have to spend time dealing with the website issue and then calling in today, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm planning to buy a VeloFit jersey instead.

That's a reasonable request given the trouble you went through. For the inconvenience caused by our system, I can certainly provide you with a 15% off coupon code. I'll include that in the same email with your return label. Would that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect. That's very fair. Thank you for resolving this so easily.

You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
